claim: For a .nex, appmake needs __register_sp and an entry symbol unless --nex-norun is used; BANK_n sections go in their bank, BANK_5, BANK_2 and BANK_0 merge into main memory, and overlapping sections abort the build.

evidence.text: appmake and section placement facts from a z88dk build; a global initialised to 0 still goes to data_compiler.
